cues.text: Inside a space station module, a plant growth chamber glows with green leafy plants beside equipment panels. A person wearing blue gloves reaches toward the panel near the chamber.

The gray-haired astronaut in a black shirt and blue gloves tends the plants inside the illuminated growth chamber, adjusting them with gloved hands. Now they lean in with both hands reaching toward the greenery.

The astronaut pulled their hands from the chamber, turned away, and floated right past the equipment panel. The view cuts back to them reaching into the plant chamber again, adjusting the green plants.

The gray-haired crew member in a black shirt and light blue disposable gloves continues tending the plants with both hands, carefully positioning the green leaves inside the chamber. They now reach in with both arms, appearing to arrange or inspect the plants.

The astronaut adjusts equipment on the panel beside the chamber, then floats out of view. The view shifts to a black panel where a red chili pepper is taped beside a white label reading "BEST BY 04/2021 / CHILI PEPPER".

The black-shirt and blue-shirt astronauts hold the bagged plant together while the green-shirt astronaut reaches for it and the dark-blue-shirt astronaut raises an arm. The green-shirt astronaut takes the plant with both hands as the others let go and watch, smiling. The dark-blue-shirt astronaut raises both arms in celebration while the black-shirt astronaut holds the plant and the blue-shirt astronaut smiles.
